edges: AC Nielsen's market research figures show pressure on Sunny Delight.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Sunny Delight reached the league table of top brands in 1999 by selling itself as a healthy drink.
The Food Commission accused the owners of selling Sunny Delight from fridge cabinets.
The decline of Sunny Delight is matched by the fall of other soft drinks.
Parents have observed that Sunny Delight did not fulfill its health claims.
The Food Commission accused the owner Procter of selling it from fridge cabinets.
Sunny Delight burst onto the market in 1998.
